utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are dropping off tools and supplies all afternoon, so it’s worth checking by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean the community center one, right? I should probably check before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, that’s the one — I’d swing by before you go, just to make sure they’re still taking drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with that repair drive. I’ll tell the others and make sure the plan gets around.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. Thanks for keeping it moving.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll spread the word and keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I can help with that. What’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just a few odds and ends: some patching, a loose hinge, and one window that still needs a new latch.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take the hinge and latch. Tell me which patching spots need the most work.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you point me to what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I can point you to the list once I check what’s left on hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, I can take a look once you’ve checked the list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after school pickup, if the timing works for you.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That works for me, Faye. I’ll line up the repair drive around your pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can come by after breakfast and we’ll go over the repair drive step by step.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Eli. I might need you to remind me which wrench goes where, but I’ll be there after breakfast.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure thing. I’ll keep it simple and steady, and we’ll sort out each wrench one by one.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling folks about it this afternoon, Pia. If you want in, I can put your name on the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Put me down for it, but I need to know the timing and whether I should bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll send over the timing as soon as I’ve got it, and you don’t need to bring anything unless you want to chip in with a few gloves or snacks.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive happening, but I’m still catching up on the details. Is there something I should bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can bring some gloves and maybe a box of basic tools if that helps. Just tell me where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to check the details first. What exactly needs repairing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mostly the usual stuff: loose pipes, faulty wiring, and a few broken doors and windows. I’m keeping a list as people check things in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it. I’ll wait to hear the full list before doing anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help, but I need the actual user request. Please resend it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m a bit late too - what’s the actual repair drive request?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The repair drive is just to gather donated tools and parts for neighbors who need small fixes done. I can send the details over once I have the actual request.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Count me in, Mina. I’ve got a few tools ready, and I can help however you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. Can you handle the heavier stuff and help me sort the tools by the garage door?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll get the heavy items moved and line up the tools by the garage door.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can head over after I finish up here. Where did you want me to meet you for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll meet you by the side entrance on Maple, near the blue bench.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Rey — I can bring over my drill and a couple wrenches if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. That should cover it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll bring them by in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but we need to make sure the repair drive is scheduled before anything gets dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is actually scheduled before anyone drops anything off, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s scheduled before the drop-off. We just need to stick to that order.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that if you want to drop off a few things or point people to the right place.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a big help, Jules. I can point people your way and bring over a few things later today.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mara. I’ll point people your way and be ready for the drop-off later today.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring over some extra screws and brackets if you need them. Just tell me what the drive still lacks.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still checking what’s missing, but those sound like the last parts we needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll hold onto the screws and brackets until you’ve finished the check.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they’re organizing the repair drive this weekend. I can ask around and see who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, thanks. I can help spread the word after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll swing by a few neighbors after lunch and see who still needs tools or a hand. Then I can tell you what I find after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo. Could you take the north side and bring a few basic tools? I’ll send the list and timing by tonight.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll handle the north side and bring a few basic tools. Send the timing when you can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Leo. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Tell me which repair needs the most attention, and I’ll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d start with whatever’s urgent, then I can take the next repair after that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, good timing - I’ve been telling people about the repair drive too. Come by and I’ll point you to the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks. I’ll stop by and take a look at the sheet.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll be by the sheet later if you have questions.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can swing by the repair drive after I check the north lot first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine, as long as we keep it to one stop and stay on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll stay on schedule and make the north lot my only stop before I head to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When does the repair drive start, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the schedule now, but I think it starts Saturday morning. Please bring any broken items and, if you can, the parts or photos of what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. I’ll bring those. Do you want me there right at Saturday morning start, or a little before?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving along. I can stop by after errands and see what still needs hands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira. I may have lost track of a few things, so that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Appreciate it. I’ll swing by after my errands and keep it simple: just point me to whatever’s still unfinished.
